properties.site-address: Land at Kiln Place (Blocks 1-64 65-80 81-96 97-104 105-116 117-164; entrance ways into 81-96; land between 81-96 and 117-164; land between Kiln Place and Meru Close; land to east of Kiln Place and playground between blocks 65-80 and 81-96) London
properties.notes: Development of 15 residential units on 6 sites across Kiln Place estate, following demolition of foyer entrances and refuse storage area for blocks 1-64, 65-80, 81-96, 97-104, 105-116, 117-164 Kiln Place along with provision of new pathway and front entrances into lower maisonettes of 81-96 Kiln Place, enlargement and improvement of playground & landscaping, and other associated works.
